Class MonitorDevice

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Screen
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Manages monitor information and handles monitor-related events in the application. Provides functionality to detect and respond to monitor changes, such as disconnection, display setup changes, or switching the active monitor.
